text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُۥ ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَن قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction fused to the opening negation
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the prior denial of rival agency into the intercession question. It makes 34:23 a continuation of 34:22 rather than a detached topic, and its fused opening lets continuity and negation arrive together.

topics.headline: resumptive continuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah continue the prior demolition of rival agency into the last possible avenue, intercession.
topics.reason: The connector resumes the preceding argument and introduces a new negated clause.

topics.headline: boundary and restriction arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks a boundary movement from no ownership or helpers in 34:22 to no autonomous intercession in 34:23.
topics.reason: Boundary and recitational rows tie the opening connector to the wider restriction frame.

topics.headline: fused opening surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices continuation and negation compressed into one visible launch.
topics.reason: The orthographic fusion makes the discourse link part of the written surface.

words.gloss_range: negation governing the benefit verb before the exception narrows it
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) sets non-benefit as the default field before any exception is heard. Because the negator is bound into the opening launch and then answered by the later exception particle, the exception can only carve out a permission-defined case, so the ayah denies autonomous efficacy rather than merely qualifying it.

topics.headline: negated benefit scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial aimed at effective avail, not at the bare existence of intercession.
topics.reason: The negative particle governs the imperfect benefit verb in the main clause.

topics.headline: negation-exception restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the exception as a narrow authorization carve-out after total exclusion.
topics.reason: The restriction construction excludes autonomous benefit and preserves only the permitted case.

topics.headline: bound negator and particle echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negator is visually tied to the opening and locally paired with the exception particle.
topics.reason: The particle is bound in the opening form and echoed by the exception mechanism.

words.gloss_range: standing denial of practical benefit from intercession under divine jurisdiction
words.root_gloss_range: practical avail, useful effect, and produced advantage; local use tests efficacy rather than prestige
words.prose: {{ar:تَنفَعُ}} ({{tr:tanfaʿu}}) puts practical effect under negation before the institution is named. Its verb-first order and feminine agreement make non-efficacy audible first; its simple imperfect states a continuing rule of ordinary avail, while the surrounding authority-domain and exception test whether mediation produces real advantage under permission.

topics.headline: verb-first non-benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears failure of benefit before hearing the familiar institution that might otherwise frame the verse.
topics.reason: The feminine imperfect agrees with the delayed subject and lets the verb lead the clause.

topics.headline: practical avail tested
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that prestige is stripped away and only actual produced advantage is being measured.
topics.reason: The root field points to concrete utility and the clause places that utility under permission.

topics.headline: standing simple form and sound-link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a continuing rule of ordinary avail and hears benefit bound to intercession as a judged pair.
topics.reason: The imperfect and simple stem state ongoing effect, while local sound rows bind the benefit verb to the intercession noun.

words.gloss_range: the recognized institution of intercession, abstracted from any named intercessor and judged by benefit
words.root_gloss_range: pairing and added advocacy; local use keeps the added-support image but denies autonomous efficacy
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ}} ({{tr:al-shafāʿatu}}) enters as the delayed definite institution whose efficacy has already been denied. Its verbal-noun form tests the mechanism rather than naming an intercessor, and its root image keeps added advocacy visible: as in restricted-mediation formulas such as 2:255, the ayah asks whether a second party can change a case, then removes any inherent force from that addition outside permission.

topics.headline: definite delayed institution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the known institution enter already under the verdict of non-benefit.
topics.reason: The definite verbal noun is the delayed subject of the negated benefit verb.

topics.headline: pairing-advocacy image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root image of adding a second party is precisely what the ayah subjects to permission.
topics.reason: The root field joins pairing and advocacy while the local clause denies independent effect.

topics.headline: gerund and formula profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the intercession mechanism rather than a named intercessor, while hearing it as part of restricted-mediation formulas such as 2:255.
topics.reason: The verbal noun abstracts the institution, and formula rows link it to permission-restricted intercession.

words.gloss_range: divine presence-domain as jurisdiction over whether intercession can avail
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, possession, presence, and stance; local use narrows these to authority-domain rather than leverage by proximity
words.prose: {{ar:عِندَهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:ʿindahu}}) places the whole benefit question inside His authority-domain before the exception appears. The suffix carries the divine referent forward, and the later title of height reorients nearness as hierarchy rather than leverage.

topics.headline: jurisdiction before exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the exception operating inside His domain, not as pressure imported from outside it.
topics.reason: The adverbial authority-domain attaches to the benefit verb and precedes the exception.

topics.headline: nearness narrowed to jurisdiction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps nearness and possession pressure, while local syntax narrows it to jurisdiction instead of intimacy or leverage.
topics.reason: The suffixed divine referent and permission frame select authority-domain from the broader range.

topics.headline: suffix continuity and height echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the divine referent from prior suffixes to the final explicit subject and height title.
topics.reason: The attached suffix compresses referential continuity and is answered conceptually by the closing height predicate.

words.gloss_range: exception particle restricting the broad denial to a permission-defined case
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) turns broad non-benefit into exclusive restriction. It scopes over the whole permission relation, so the surviving case is defined by authorization rather than by a privileged identity alone.

topics.headline: permission-defined exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the exception as the full permission relation, not merely an unnamed person.
topics.reason: The exception particle scopes over the following relational clause.

topics.headline: binary efficacy filter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that autonomous intercessory efficacy is reduced to zero outside permission.
topics.reason: The negation-exception structure isolates the only surviving case.

words.gloss_range: preposition making the exception relational, allocated, and beneficiary-oriented
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) makes the exception relational before the permission verb arrives. The ayah does not simply name an excluded person; it marks a directed or allocated relation that permission will define, and the clitic lām is echoed by the later lām-complement so the permission verb is framed by relation markers.

topics.headline: relational exception case
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees eligibility as allocation or benefit, not as a bare named class.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the relative pronoun in the exceptive phrase.

topics.headline: benefit and allocation force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first hears that the exception is for someone, then learns authorization defines that someone.
topics.reason: The preposition can carry benefit, entitlement, and directed relation together.

topics.headline: clitic relation envelope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the permission verb framed by repeated relation markers.
topics.reason: The prefixed preposition and later complement create a compact relational envelope.

words.gloss_range: open rational relative pronoun whose identity is defined by permission
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) keeps the permitted party unnamed and open. Its following relative clause supplies the boundary, so status, lineage, or social identity cannot replace the permission condition; the exception concerns an authorized person, agent, beneficiary, or case rather than an automatic mechanism.

topics.headline: unnamed open class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that no privileged group is named in the exception.
topics.reason: The pronoun opens a rational class defined by the following permission clause.

topics.headline: moral-legal relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exception concerns authorized persons, agents, beneficiaries, or cases rather than automatic causality.
topics.reason: The pronoun selects a person-capable referent and can function relatively or indefinitely.

words.gloss_range: settled authorization granted in a relational complement frame
words.root_gloss_range: permission, hearing, and notice; local use selects authorization while keeping speech-reception pressure nearby
words.prose: {{ar:أَذِنَ}} ({{tr:adhina}}) makes permission the completed condition on which benefit depends. Its complement is relational rather than a direct object, and the root field of hearing and notice prepares the later question about what the Lord said without turning this verb into proclamation. Active and passive reading pressure can shift how visible the permitter is, but not the sovereignty of the permission rule.

topics.headline: settled permission condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees authorization completed before the threshold scene and dialogue begin.
topics.reason: The perfect verb completes the exception before the next scene marker.

topics.headline: hearing and authorization field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects permission with sanctioned hearing and later speech, while local grammar keeps permission as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root field includes ear, notice, and permission; the local clause selects leave.

topics.headline: active-passive agency boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that variant agency visibility changes grammar, not the sovereignty of the permission rule.
topics.reason: Active and passive readings affect explicit agency while the surrounding lordship frame keeps authority fixed.

words.gloss_range: compact prepositional pronoun sealing permission as allocated relation
words.prose: {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) closes the exception with a compact relational tail instead of a named privileged class. The suffix can track the permitted party, beneficiary, or case; that ambiguity keeps authorization central and identity secondary, while the repeated pronoun shape across the boundary reverses dependency from no helper for Him to permission for another.

topics.headline: allocated pronoun complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees permission grammatically assigned without becoming named status.
topics.reason: The prepositional pronoun completes the permission verb as an allocated relation.

topics.headline: role ambiguity preserved
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah refuses to specify whether authorization centers on speaker, recipient, or case.
topics.reason: The pronoun can carry to, for, or concerning senses in the local permission frame.

topics.headline: compact tail and boundary echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks a repeated pronoun shape across the boundary, with dependency reversed from no helper for Him to permission for another.
topics.reason: The compact form seals the exception and echoes prior pronoun language.

words.gloss_range: threshold particle shifting from rule to temporal-result scene
words.prose: {{ar:حَتَّىٰٓ}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) moves the ayah from the abstract restriction rule into the staged moment before speech. Endpoint and result converge: the fear-clearing scene is both what comes next and the point to which the permission argument drives, and the visibly lengthened surface supports the feel of a stretched threshold.

topics.headline: temporal-result threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the scene after the rule as threshold and consequence, not as a disconnected insert.
topics.reason: The particle can mark endpoint and result, both fitting the transition into the fear-clearing clause.

topics.headline: rule-to-scene hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah dramatizes the rule through embodied reception.
topics.reason: The particle pivots from efficacy restriction to hearts being cleared and speech beginning.

topics.headline: stretched transition form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the marked long surface support the feeling of a stretched threshold.
topics.reason: The visible lengthening coincides with the transition function of the particle.

words.gloss_range: temporal-conditional marker making response depend on completed inner clearing
words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) makes the later saying depend on the completed clearing of hearts. The scene is vivid and repeatable: once the inner threshold is crossed, speech can begin, but not before.

topics.headline: condition for response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees speech as dependent on prior inner clearing, not confident access.
topics.reason: The temporal condition governs the response verb after the heart-clearing clause.

topics.headline: vivid completed threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the threshold as complete at the moment response becomes possible.
topics.reason: The particle with a perfect passive stages a vivid completed event with general force.

words.gloss_range: forceful passive clearing of alarm from hearts before speech
words.root_gloss_range: alarm, fright, urgent recourse, and relief; local construction selects removal of alarm while preserving rescue pressure
words.prose: {{ar:فُزِّعَ}} ({{tr:fuzziʿa}}) is the embodied threshold verb. Its rare, doubled passive Form II focuses on hearts released from shock while hiding the remover; the following separation phrase makes alarm move away from hearts, and variant images of active agency or emptying sharpen the same clearing function without replacing the local fear-removal sense.

topics.headline: passive clearing event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees alarm removed from hearts, with the affected inner state foregrounded over the mechanics of removal.
topics.reason: The passive verb and separation complement make the event directional and deagentivized.

topics.headline: terror-relief root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the move from helpless alarm to enough relief for speech.
topics.reason: The root field holds fright and urgent recourse, while the local construction selects relief from alarm.

topics.headline: form variants and rare jolt
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices forceful de-stunning in the main form, while variants illuminate agency or emptying without governing the local parse.
topics.reason: Form II passive gemination is local; active and alternate-dot variants are contrastive evidence.

words.gloss_range: separation preposition selecting removal from hearts
words.prose: {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) fixes the direction of the passive event: alarm is cleared away from the hearts. The preposition prevents a merely locative reading and makes the inner faculty the site from which a burden is removed, with the particle bound directly to the heart plural it governs.

topics.headline: away-from direction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees fear lifted from hearts rather than simply located there.
topics.reason: The preposition after the passive verb marks separation and removal.

topics.headline: selected removal sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition mediates the path from event to inner faculty.
topics.reason: Although the preposition has broader values, the local verb selects away-from.

topics.headline: sound binding to hearts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the removal particle bound directly to the heart plural it governs.
topics.reason: The nasal close supports tight syntactic attachment.

words.gloss_range: plural possessed hearts as the cleared inner faculties before speech
words.root_gloss_range: turning, inner center, reversal, and cognitive faculty; local use makes hearts the source-site of removed alarm and restored reception
words.prose: {{ar:قُلُوبِهِمْ}} ({{tr:qulūbihim}}) makes the inner faculties the cleared site rather than direct objects. The plural suffix links these hearts to the later speakers, so the speech chain emerges only after many inner centers have turned from stunned alarm into restored reception.

topics.headline: cleared inner site
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees hearts as the source-site from which alarm is removed just before dialogue opens.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the separation preposition and closes the threshold clause.

topics.headline: turning heart reception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the heart as a turning faculty restored from alarm into inquiry.
topics.reason: The root image of turning fits the transition from stunned inner state to speech-ready understanding.

topics.headline: plural witness field and echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears inner state move outward into the repeated saying verbs.
topics.reason: The broken plural and suffix multiply the inner scene, and local echoes bind hearts to speech.

words.gloss_range: first plural saying verb introducing the recovered question after fear-clearing
words.root_gloss_range: utterance and saying; local use externalizes restored inner reception as dependent inquiry
words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) is the first speech after the hearts are cleared. The same plural form will later answer, but here it introduces a question; human speech begins as dependent inquiry around the Lord speech, not as independent knowledge.

topics.headline: response after clearing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the speakers as the recovered owners of the cleared hearts.
topics.reason: The perfect plural verb answers the temporal condition and resumes the prior plural suffix.

topics.headline: inquiry speech act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first recovered utterance seeks the Lord speech rather than making a claim.
topics.reason: The verb introduces the quoted question and turns inner recovery into audible inquiry.

topics.headline: speech-chain launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first verb launch a three-part chain: question, divine saying, answer.
topics.reason: The repeated saying verbs differ by role while forming one speech architecture.

words.gloss_range: content-question asking what the Lord said
words.prose: {{ar:مَاذَا}} ({{tr:mādhā}}) turns recovered speech into a content question. The speakers do not ask who spoke; they ask what was said, so the one-word truth-answer can satisfy the gap created by the interrogative.

topics.headline: quoted content question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees epistemic dependence: speech has returned, but the content of divine saying must still be reported.
topics.reason: The interrogative functions as the object or content of the embedded speech verb.

topics.headline: what-content compression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a broad request for content will be compressed into one answer noun.
topics.reason: The fused interrogative can still carry analyzable what-thing pressure while asking as one word.

topics.headline: hinge to truth-answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the question as the bridge from fear-clearing to truth recognition.
topics.reason: The interrogative makes the following truth word an answer rather than a detached declaration.

words.gloss_range: central singular saying verb whose source is the Lord
words.root_gloss_range: utterance and communication; local use treats divine saying as binding content to be known
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) is the concise center of the speech chain. The fronted question presses for content before the subject is named, but the following Lord-title fixes the source, so human question and answer revolve around one authoritative divine saying.

topics.headline: central divine saying
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the utterance as explicit source-speech, not anonymous report.
topics.reason: The active singular verb takes the Lord-title as overt subject.

topics.headline: binding communication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the Lord saying as truth-defining communication, not casual speech.
topics.reason: The local answer identifies the spoken content as truth, giving the verb binding force.

topics.headline: singular within plural frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears one authoritative saying enclosed by plural human sayings.
topics.reason: The central singular form is bracketed by two plural forms in the speech chain.

words.gloss_range: relational Lord-title as explicit subject of the divine saying
words.root_gloss_range: mastery, ownership, nurturing, governance, and sustaining rule; local use makes the speaker the addressees sustaining Lord
words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbukum}}) names the source of the central saying as your Lord, a singular owner, governor, and sustainer over a plural audience. The construct suffix makes the speech relational and prepares the final explicit pronoun that will carry this referent into the closing titles.

topics.headline: explicit Lord source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the central utterance locked to the Lord rather than to the plural speakers.
topics.reason: The noun is the overt subject after the speech verb and closes the question clause.

topics.headline: sustaining governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that truth comes from the owner, governor, and sustainer, not merely from a powerful voice.
topics.reason: The root field combines mastery, nurture, ownership, and governance.

topics.headline: relational construct and authority echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears lordship as directly related to the addressed group and then carried into the final pronoun.
topics.reason: The construct with second-person plural suffix makes the title definite and relational.

words.gloss_range: second plural saying verb introducing the decisive truth-answer
words.root_gloss_range: utterance and saying; local use turns recovered speech into collective testimony
words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) repeats the plural saying form but changes role from question to answer. After the central Lord-speech, the same speakers return as witnesses, and their speech compresses the reply into truth rather than reopening negotiation.

topics.headline: answer speech role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same morphology perform a new discourse task: answer rather than inquiry.
topics.reason: The second plural verb governs the truth-content as its reply.

topics.headline: collective testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recovered speakers certify the Lord saying as truth.
topics.reason: The saying verb now performs recognition and testimony.

topics.headline: speech-chain resolution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the three-part speech chain close: human inquiry, divine saying, human answer.
topics.reason: The final plural saying resolves the repeated speech sequence.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative truth-answer, compressed as the payload of the reply
words.root_gloss_range: truth, reality, rightness, due claim, fittingness, and binding obligation; local use holds fact and due judgment together
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَقَّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqa}}) is the one-word payload of the answer. Its accusative form makes truth the spoken content, while the root range makes that content both reality and binding due judgment; the nominative variant exposes a related predicative pressure, but the local reading keeps the answer governed by the preceding saying verb.

topics.headline: accusative truth payload
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees truth as the spoken payload of the answer, not a detached slogan.
topics.reason: The accusative definite noun functions as quoted content or object after the answer verb.

topics.headline: truth right and due
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the answer names reality and binding rightness at once.
topics.reason: The root field joins truth, fact, right, and due obligation in the local answer.

topics.headline: compressed answer and variant pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the whole question collapse into one known noun while seeing that the nominative variant would make Truth stand as a full predicate.
topics.reason: The local accusative parse remains governed by the preceding verb, while the variant supplies contrast.

words.gloss_range: closing conjunction linking the truth-answer to the final nominal attribute clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) turns the truth-answer toward the final attribute seal. Whether read as resumption or circumstantial framing, the closing predicates ground the answer in who He is rather than adding a separate event; fused to the pronoun, the connector visibly attaches the final clause to the answer while echoing the ayah's opening connector.

topics.headline: truth-answer to attribute link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final titles as grounding the truth-answer, not as an afterthought.
topics.reason: The conjunction joins the reported answer to the nominal attribute clause.

topics.headline: resumptive and circumstantial frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can keep both resumption and state-framing, while neither value turns the titles into another event.
topics.reason: Both readings are locally workable and converge in grounding the answer.

topics.headline: fused final launch and bookend
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final clause visibly attached to the answer while beginning a new predication and echoing the opening connector.
topics.reason: The conjunction is fused to the pronoun and forms a closing envelope with the opening connector.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun anchoring the final predicates to the divine referent
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) re-centers the divine referent after a chain of plural verbs. The independent pronoun carries the same referent from earlier suffixes and the Lord-title into explicit subjecthood, so the final clause halts the motion of events and speech in stable predication.

topics.headline: explicit divine subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final titles anchored to the divine referent, not drifting toward the plural speakers.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun serves as explicit subject of the nominal clause.

topics.headline: lordship to title routing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same referent from earlier suffixes and the Lord-title into the final predicates.
topics.reason: The pronoun resumes the divine referent and routes it into the attribute seal.

topics.headline: nominal closure stability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah stop in stable identity rather than another action.
topics.reason: After multiple verbs, the pronoun opens a verbless predicate clause with a slower cadence.

words.gloss_range: first definite predicate-title: exalted height as stable authority
words.root_gloss_range: height, rising, superiority, and exalted rank; local title narrows this to inherent divine authority, not contested striving for superiority
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَلِىُّ}} ({{tr:al-ʿaliyyu}}) is the first closing predicate and reads as a definite title, not a passing description, comparison, or event of rising. It answers the earlier presence-domain by making nearness vertical: intercession, permission, and speech occur before One whose authority is enduringly exalted above all claimants, and the title pairs formally with the final greatness title.

topics.headline: definite first title predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees exaltedness stated as stable identity in the final nominal clause.
topics.reason: The definite nominative title functions as the first predicate of the explicit pronoun.

topics.headline: height as sovereignty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices vertical superiority reinterpreting the earlier presence-domain, while local title use excludes leverage by proximity.
topics.reason: The root range includes height and superiority; the divine title selects inherent exalted authority.

topics.headline: title form and paired cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees enduring exaltedness rather than comparison or an event of rising, and hears the first title pair with the final title.
topics.reason: The definite adjective pattern states settled quality and forms a balanced closure with the next title.

words.gloss_range: second definite predicate-title: settled greatness, magnitude, and gravity closing the ayah
words.root_gloss_range: greatness, size, seniority, weight, gravity, and self-magnification branches; local title selects real divine magnitude over human claim
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكَبِيرُ}} ({{tr:al-kabīru}}) lands the ayah on unshared greatness as a settled title. As the second definite predicate, it stacks magnitude onto height; against the opening problem of added advocacy, the final word's weight says no second party can enlarge a case before the Great.

topics.headline: second definite title predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees greatness stacked with height as one closing identity-frame.
topics.reason: The definite title is a second predicate of the explicit pronoun without a new clause.

topics.headline: magnitude answers intercession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final magnitude answer the opening logic of adding an advocate.
topics.reason: The root field adds scale, gravity, and weight, dwarfing the pairing logic of intercession.

topics.headline: settled title and final weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the last word carry the ayah away from fear scene into the scale of the One governing it.
topics.reason: The definite adjective pattern and final cadence make greatness an enduring title with closure weight.

branches.scope_ar: يدخل فيه قال يقول قولا، والقول والقيل، والكلام المركب من الحروف إذا أبرز بالنطق، مفردا كان أو جملة أو قصيدة أو خطبة.

variants.scope_en: Includes saying, utterance, qawl/qil, and articulated speech made of letters, whether word, sentence, poem, or sermon.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ ... إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُۥ (words 2, 3, 7)
baseline_models.mechanism: The sh-f-ʿ image joins an advocate to another's need, n-f-ʿ asks whether that joining has real efficacy, and ʾ-dh-n makes efficacy contingent on granted license. Relation alone carries no power.

activation_trace.role: The benefit-versus-harm image supplies the efficacy whose denial and conditional restoration the clause measures.
Joining an advocate to another supplies the relational act whose independent efficacy is denied.
Permission and license supply the gate that makes the joined appeal operative.

changed_reading.before: Intercession is generally effective, with permission merely selecting its cases.
changed_reading.after: Intercession has no native efficacy; an added advocate or plea becomes beneficial only inside a granted authorization.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَن قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا ... قَالُوا ٱلْحَقَّ (words 11-19)
baseline_models.mechanism: The passive f-z-ʿ branch removes fear from the heart as apprehending center before a threefold saying sequence culminates in truth. The exception therefore unfolds as thresholded communication, not only as a legal rule.

activation_trace.role: The image of fear being uncovered and removed supplies the threshold that releases the ensuing dialogue.
Heart as understanding and inward apprehension supplies the site cleared for reception.
Articulated speech supplies the staged question, reported saying, and answer after fear clears.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the dialogue's terminal content.

changed_reading.before: The second half merely depicts frightened onlookers after an intercession rule.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a communication threshold: inward fear must be removed before the Lord's saying can be queried, relayed, and acknowledged as truth.

baseline_models.mechanism: Nearness or presence is enclosed by divine elevation and greatness. Intercession occurs in an asymmetrical sovereign audience, not in negotiation among peers.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and presence supply the standing in which the intercessory act is attempted.
Elevation supplies the vertical asymmetry between every participant and the Lord.
Majesty and rightful greatness close the scene against peer-level bargaining.

changed_reading.before: At Him is a neutral location for an otherwise familiar appeal.
changed_reading.after: At Him denotes admitted standing inside radical hierarchy; proximity never turns the authorized speaker into a co-sovereign.

baseline_models.mechanism: The non-advocacy sh-f-ʿ branch makes one into two by addition. Read beside permission, it offers an exploratory image of an admissible second voice being attached to a solitary case without owning the outcome.

activation_trace.role: Making one into a pair supplies the branch-level image of adding a second voice or relation.
License supplies the rule that determines whether the addition is admissible.

changed_reading.before: Shafāʿa can only be heard as a patron's advocacy.
changed_reading.after: At branch level it can also image authorized addition: a case is paired with another voice, while efficacy remains wholly granted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, invoked others are denied atom-weight ownership, any share, and any supporting role; later, parties cannot own benefit or harm for one another. The permission exception authorizes an occurrence without transferring a stock of power.

activation_trace.role: The advocate joining another supplies the focus relation tested for efficacy.
Ownership and disposal supply the exact autonomous capacity denied to the invoked others.
Participation and shared stake supply a second possible basis of efficacy that the verse denies.
Strengthening by a backer supplies the support model denied immediately before intercession is mentioned.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the later explicit denial of reciprocal efficacy.
Harm as benefit's contrary completes the field over which creatures lack disposal.

structural_cues: The 34:22 denial of ownership, share, and backing directly precedes the sole permission exception in 34:23.
34:42 later repeats the benefit lexeme while denying reciprocal benefit and harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denials of ownership, share, backing, and reciprocal benefit or harm; I infer that permission authorizes an act without transferring power. A live alternative is that 34:42 narrows its denial to the condemned parties while the focus exception leaves its beneficiary unspecified.

changed_reading.before: The exception is a loophole through which approved patrons retain a smaller independent power.
changed_reading.after: The exception seals the anti-autonomy claim: a permitted intercession may occur, but no intercessor owns, shares, backs, or dispenses its benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same permission root governs jinn working before Solomon under the Lord's command, with deviation sanctioned. That operational scene recasts focus permission as a bounded commission rather than a status privilege.

activation_trace.role: License supplies the focus gate whose operational character is being tested.
Permission and license explicitly delimit another creaturely service performed before a ruler.
Purposive work supplies the authorized task rather than an inherent office.
Deviation from straightness supplies the possibility of exceeding the commission.
Binding command supplies the boundary from which deviation is punished.

structural_cues: 34:12 combines work, being before a ruler, the same permission root, command, deviation, and sanction in one clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies work performed by permission and punished deviation from command; I infer an analogy from controlled service to the intercessory speaking role. A live alternative is that eschatological speech permission functions differently from Solomonic labor permission.

changed_reading.before: Permission is a one-time yes granted to a favored personality.
changed_reading.after: Permission reads as a bounded commission: the intercessory or speaking role is assigned service under command, with no independent remit.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 34:26 the Lord gathers the parties and opens or decides between them with truth. This judicial use lets the focus answer ٱلْحَقَّ name not only truthful content but the decisive truth-verdict just uttered.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the question about the Lord's saying and the reported answer.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the potentially verdict-like content of the answer.
Gathering dispersed parties supplies the judicial assembly in which truth acts.
Opening an impasse by judgment supplies the decisive function assigned to truth.
Truth against falsehood supplies the criterion and medium of the Lord's decision.

structural_cues: The repeated speech commands of 34:24-26 culminate in the Lord gathering and deciding between opposed parties with truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a Lord-centered gathering and judicial opening with truth; I infer that the focus's elliptical answer can name the resulting verdict. A live alternative is that ٱلْحَقَّ remains only a general characterization of whatever was said.

changed_reading.before: They answer only that the Lord's statement is factually true.
changed_reading.after: They may be naming the Lord's decisive truth-verdict, whose utterance opens and separates the gathered dispute; the scene is judicial as well as epistemic.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah truth descends from the Lord, creatures fail to know the hidden, the Lord casts truth, and guidance comes by concealed disclosure to a hearing recipient. The focus dialogue becomes a derivative relay: recipients wait, are cleared, ask, and repeat rather than originating knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the relay's sequence of source-question-answer.
Sending something down and delivering it supplies the Lord-to-recipient direction of truth.
What is hidden from sight supplies the knowledge creatures demonstrably do not possess on their own.
Casting speech supplies a directional projection of truth from the Lord rather than its production by hearers.
Imparting knowledge in concealment supplies the channel by which derivative guidance arrives.
Hearing sounds supplies reception at the endpoint of the disclosure channel.

structural_cues: 34:6 identifies what is sent down from the Lord as truth; 34:14 exposes creaturely ignorance of the unseen.
34:48-50 place casting truth, knowledge of hidden things, revelation, hearing, and nearness in one closing sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, hiddenness, cast speech, concealed disclosure, and hearing; I infer a one-way epistemic arrow from the Lord to recipients and then into their answer. A live alternative is that the focus question verifies a decree after transmission but does not describe intercession's own mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The intercessors already know the case and use speech to influence the outcome.
changed_reading.after: The unit is also an epistemic relay: permission and fear-clearance govern when derivative speakers may receive and repeat Lord-originated truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close parallel عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰ denies that wealth or children produce nearness and assigns the relevant path to faith and work; the closing revelation scene calls the Lord hearing and near. Focus عِندَهُ is therefore relational standing and communicative access, not geometry or purchasable court influence.

activation_trace.role: Nearness, presence, and rank supply the focus standing redefined by the later parallel.
Possessed wealth supplies one social credential explicitly denied the power to secure nearness.
Descendants supply the inherited relation explicitly denied the power to secure nearness.
Favor and privileged nearness to a sovereign supply the status that wealth and lineage cannot create.
Near rank and standing make the verse's target explicitly relational rather than merely spatial.
Purposive action supplies the non-transferable qualification paired with faith.
Nearness opposed to distance supplies communicative availability despite the focus's divine elevation.

structural_cues: 34:37 repeats the focus's ʿinda construction as عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰ and explicitly tests wealth, descendants, faith, and action as routes to it.
34:50 joins revelation to divine hearing and nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact ʿinda-nearness parallel and denies wealth and lineage as its causes; I infer that focus proximity is admitted standing, not spatial adjacency or patronage capital. A live alternative is that 34:37 concerns beneficiaries while 34:23's permitted party may instead be the speaker.

changed_reading.before: At Him is a place where social assets or favored connections might be converted into influence.
changed_reading.after: At Him is granted standing that wealth, descendants, and distance cannot manufacture; authorized joining does not detach access from faith and action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah separates what opposed parties are asked about, then stages weak and arrogant groups returning blame-speech to each other before recompense is tied to what they did. Intercession may add an authorized voice, but it does not transfer deed-account or let hierarchy absorb liability.

activation_trace.role: An advocate joining another's need supplies the relation that could otherwise be mistaken for substitution of account.
Reciprocal questioning supplies the paired denial that each side is asked for the other's deeds.
Returning speech and answers supplies the blame loop contrasted with the focus's truth-answer.
Weakness opposed to power supplies one side of the failed patron-client hierarchy.
Human self-greatness supplies the dominating side whose status cannot absorb another's liability.
Matching action with recompense supplies the return of outcome to each party's deeds.
Purposive action supplies the account to which recompense remains attached.

structural_cues: 34:25 separates the two parties' questioned acts; 34:31-33 then expands their exchanged speech but closes on recompense for what they themselves did.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separated questioning, a hierarchical blame exchange, and deed-matched recompense; I infer that authorized joining cannot become liability transfer. A live alternative is that these passages regulate polemical responsibility without directly defining what intercession can affect.

changed_reading.before: An approved advocate can stand in for another's moral account or make a patron's rank answer for a client.
changed_reading.after: Authorization can add speech or aid, but it neither transfers deeds nor lets weak and great parties exchange responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later gathered scene repeats divine question and plural answer: angels are asked about human worship, identify God rather than themselves as patron, and are followed by denial of mutual benefit. This activates heavenly participants as summoned truth-witnesses who disown patronage, not recruitable dispensers of aid.

activation_trace.role: The focus's articulated question and plural answer supply the dialogue pattern replayed later.
Driving and gathering a group to one destination supplies the formal assembly for the later examination.
The angel branch identifies the heavenly answerers in the parallel divine dialogue.
Their articulated answer supplies truthful disavowal rather than an intercessory claim to power.
Love, alliance, and support supply the patron relation the angels reserve for God.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the efficacy denied immediately after the angels' answer.

structural_cues: 34:40-41 repeats Lord-centered question followed by plural answer, then 34:42 denies reciprocal benefit.
The later answer expressly redirects patronage away from the heavenly speakers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a parallel divine dialogue with angels, their patronage disavowal, and a benefit denial; I infer a role analogy to the focus answerers. A live alternative is that the parallel does not identify the focus pronouns as angels and only models how heavenly agents speak.

changed_reading.before: Heavenly intercessors are patrons whom worshippers can enlist for beneficial influence.
changed_reading.after: Potential heavenly participants appear as summoned truth-speaking witnesses who disown rival allegiance; any aid remains a permitted role, not patronage they own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus removes fear before truthful speech, while 34:51 turns panic into no escape and seizure; 34:52 makes late belief unreachable from afar, and 34:54 installs a barrier before desire. Fear-clearance is therefore timely admission to reception, not a last-minute mechanism for gaining access.

activation_trace.role: Removal and uncovering of fear supplies the focus pathway from alarm into truthful dialogue.
Panic before the frightening event supplies the contrasting fear that proceeds to capture rather than clearance.
Failure to reach or escape supplies the closure of available movement after panic.
Reaching by extension supplies the access now declared unavailable.
Distance opposed to nearness supplies the condition that defeats belated reaching.
An intervening barrier supplies the final separation between persons and what they seek.

structural_cues: The focus sequence is fear removed, question, truth; the closing sequence is panic, no escape, failed reaching, and barrier.
Near and far language turns the contrast into one of timely access as well as affect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite f-z-ʿ outcomes and a closing reach-distance-barrier sequence; I infer that timely fear-clearance marks admission to truth while terminal panic cannot create access. A live alternative is that the two fear scenes concern different groups without a designed contrast.

changed_reading.before: Fear removal is generic reassurance and panic itself might prompt a late appeal.
changed_reading.after: Fear removal marks timely admission into truthful reception; later panic has no reach, so belated belief cannot recruit the focus exception.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the arithmetic pairing branch of sh-f-ʿ rather than the ordinary advocacy branch. It remains anchored in the focus noun and is activated by 34:46's explicit paired-versus-single deliberation before God; downstream prose should present it as a lexical-structural echo, not as a replacement translation of shafāʿa or an equation of intercession with reflection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ (word 3), heard through the branch image of adding one to one

activation_trace.role: Adding one to its like supplies the latent image of an authorized second voice.
Joining one to one and making two supplies the explicit paired state that activates the focus branch.
The solitary one supplies the contrast showing that pairing adds relation without erasing individual standing.
The heart's repeated movement over a matter supplies a deliberative rather than patronage-driven use of pairing.

changed_reading.before: Intercession is only a patron's plea replacing solitary exposure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is an authorized addition that turns one into a pair: relation can add testimony or aid without cancelling solitary responsibility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy from measured, connected armor-work to the focus's joined and three-stage speech sequence. It remains anchored in sh-f-ʿ's joining branch and the repeated q-w-l construction; downstream prose should call it an image of controlled linkage, not claim that armor lexically defines intercession.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another supplies the link-image for the authorized relation.
The three articulated sayings supply successive links in the focus communication sequence.
A measure bringing a thing to its proper limit supplies control over each link's scope.
Successive things connected to one another supply the material analogy for a bounded relay.

changed_reading.before: The sayings after the permission clause are loose commentary on an independent intercession event.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the permitted act is one measured link in a connected speech-chain: the Lord says, hearers ask, and answerers relay, while no link becomes the source.

strongest_changes: Permission no longer looks like transferred power; it is a bounded commission inside a field where ownership, share, backing, and reciprocal benefit are denied.
The fear-cleared dialogue becomes both an epistemic relay and a possible judicial announcement: truth originates in the Lord and may function as decisive verdict.
At-Him proximity becomes admitted standing that wealth, descendants, distance, and belated panic cannot manufacture.
Intercession can add an authorized voice without transferring deed-account or validating human or heavenly patrons.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah echoes linked the permission formula to commanded service, replayed divine question-and-answer with angels, opposed fear-clearance to terminal panic, and activated sh-f-ʿ's pairing branch through 34:46.
remaining_uncertainties: The grammar still leaves open whether لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ centers the beneficiary, the intercessor or speaker, or a relation involving both.
The angel dialogue supplies a strong role parallel but does not by itself identify the plural pronouns in 34:23.
ٱلْحَقَّ may denote truthful content generally, a particular decree, or the Lord's decisive verdict; the context keeps all three live.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Intercession is authorized joining, not independent leverage.** `ش ف ع/B001` is joining a thing to its like, `ش ف ع/B002` joining as advocate, and `ء ذ ن/B004` permission and authorization. The exception places permission before any effective joining. Advocacy’s role is relational attachment; authorization is the gate that permits attachment to carry benefit. The packet states the gate; I infer that benefit flows only through the authorized relation. The ayah therefore preserves intercession while denying it autonomous force.
2. **Removed alarm uncovers a verbal core.** `ف ز ع/B004` is removal of alarm, `ق ل ب/B002` the pure core, and `ح ق ق/B001` firm truth. Once alarm is removed from inward faculties, repeated questioning and answering resolves to “the truth.” The packet supplies de-alarming then speech; I infer that fear had obstructed accurate reception. The scene reads as signal clarification after noise is stripped away.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:40-42 staged the face-to-face audit anticipated here: claimed worship-relations were gathered, corrected, and then stripped of every horizontal transfer capacity.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Intercession as an authorized communication link.** `ش ف ع B001` supplies joining a thing to its like, `ش ف ع B002` joining as advocate or helper, `ء ذ ن B004` authorization, and `ف ز ع B004` removal of alarm. After 34:22 denies independent shares and backers, this ayah permits a linkage only through authorization; fear is removed and a relay of questions and answers follows. The branches assign permission the gate, fear-removal the deblocking step, and speech the transmitted content. The packet supplies the sequence; I infer that access is protocol-governed. Intercession reads as licensed connection, not autonomous leverage.

2. **A heart turned from alarm into truthful speech.** `ق ل ب B004` supplies turning and reversal, while repeated Q-W-L culminates in `ٱلْحَقَّ`. The passive removal of alarm precedes the speech sequence. The branch gives the heart the role of the state that must be reversed before a true report can pass. The packet supplies the temporal order; I infer that de-alarming enables articulation. The scene reads as an affective gate in the communication mechanism.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:26 supplied a macro-scale version of the same protocol: parties are gathered, then an opening by truth occurs between them. This made 34:23's permission and fear-removal look like local gates inside a broader gather-open-disclose mechanism.

baseline.text: O'nun katında, izin verdiği kimseden başkasına şefaat yarar sağlamaz. Sonunda kalplerindeki korku giderilince, ‘Rabbiniz ne dedi?’ derler. ‘Gerçeği’ derler. O yücedir, büyüktür.

findings.text: Şefaat bağımsız bir baskı gücü değil, ancak izin kapısından geçince yarar taşıyabilen yetkili bir bağlantıdır.
Korkunun kalplerden giderilmesi, iletişimdeki gürültüyü kaldırır; iç durum tersine dönünce soru ve cevap gerçeğe ulaşır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The argument does not deny every relation at once; it distinguishes persuasion from coercion, a claim from possession, shared title from actual support, and speech from licensed mediation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Permission does more than authorize a plea; it changes the hearer's state from alarm to intelligible exchange. Valid mediation is therefore a regulated speech event.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı, zararın karşıtı olan ve iyiliğe ulaşmada araçlık eden yarar çekirdeğiyle tanımlar; ayrıca birine yarar sağlama, bir şeyden yararlanma ve insanlara sürekli yararlı olma biçimlerini bu çekirdeğe bağlar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu ilişkileri doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın sınırı genel yarar çekirdeğidir; bir şeyden yararlanma ve yararlı kişi anlatımları bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, tek başına kullanılan yarar anlamını temel alır; birine yarar sağlama, bir şeyden yararlanma ve kişiyi niteleme biçimlerini ayrı, bağımlı yüzler olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Zararın karşıtı olan ve iyiliğe ulaşmayı kolaylaştıran olumlu sonuç ya da etkidir. Bu çekirdek, birine yarar sağlama, bir şey aracılığıyla yarar elde etme ve insanlara sürekli yararlı olup zarar vermeyen kişiyi niteleme biçimlerinde gerçekleşir.

facets.statement: Zararın karşıtı olan yarar, iyiliğe ulaşmada yardımcı olan olumlu bir sonuç veya etkidir.
Eylem yönü, yararın bir başkasına ulaştırılmasını veya o kişide yararlı bir sonuç doğurulmasını bildirir.
Belirli bir şeyle kurulan kullanım, kişinin o şeyden ya da onun aracılığıyla yarar elde etmesini bildirir.
Kişi niteliği olarak, insanlara sürekli yarar sağlayan ve onlara zarar vermeyen kimseyi anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişinin başkasına katılarak onun adına istekte bulunması veya onu desteklemesi çekirdeğini açıkça verir; desteğin yararlı bir işte de düşmanlık yoluyla zararlı bir işte de görülebileceğini ayrıca korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin başkasına katılıp onun gereksinimi için üçüncü bir kişiden istekte bulunması veya onu desteklemesidir. Bu katılım yararlı ya da zararlı bir işte güç verme biçimini alabilir; düşmanlık kalıbında ise birine karşı yardım etme ya da karşı koyma yönüne döner.

facets.statement: Bir başkasının gereksinimi için onun adına istekte bulunmayı ve ona destek olmayı anlatır.
Birine yararlı veya zararlı bir işte katılarak onun eylemini güçlendirmeyi kapsar.
Düşmanlık kalıbında birine karşı yardım etmeyi veya ona hasım olarak karşı koymayı belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, bir kişinin başka birinin yanına katılıp onun adına istemesi ya da onu güçlendirmesidir; yararlı ve zararlı destek ile düşmanlık kullanımı bu katılımın yönlerini gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ev veya arazi satışında, satışla bağlantılı kişinin satın alınanı kendi malına katmak üzere sonraki isteklilerden önce gelmesini doğrular. Ancak geçici çerçevedeki komşu ve pay vurgusu bütün ifadelerde kurucu şart olarak açık değildir; güvenli sınır, geçerli bir bağlantıya dayanan öncelikli alımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam genel mülk edinme değil, ev veya arazi satışında bağlantı nedeniyle doğan öncelikli alım hakkıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ad biçimleri taşınmazdaki hakkı, eylem ise belirli bir satışta öncelik vermeyi anlatır; bunlar genel bir katma anlamına genişletilmez.

facets.statement: Ev veya arazi satışında bağlantısı bulunan isteklinin öncelikli alım hakkını belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım ev ve arazi alanındaki öncelikli alımı öne çıkarır; istekli, satışla olan bağlantısı nedeniyle sonraki kişilerin önüne geçirilir ve satılanı kendi mülküne katabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görme zayıflığı nedeniyle tek bir kişinin iki kişi gibi algılanmasını ve gözün çift görüntü üretmesini doğrudan belirtir. Geçici çerçeve bu belirli görme bozukluğunu doğru sınırlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Göz nitelemesi ile görme bozukluğunun adı aynı çift görme çekirdeğinde tutulur; anlam genel görme zayıflığına yayılmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, ana çizgide sınırı aşma, doğru olduğu bilinen şeyi geri çevirme ve ona karşı koymayı birlikte verir. Bununla birlikte birine karşı aynı işi yaparak boy ölçüşme ve devenin yuları tutana üstün gelmesi de tanıklanır; bu kullanımların tümünü yalnızca doğruyu reddetme diye açıklamak kapsamı gereksiz yere daraltır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ana anlam bilinçli karşı koyma ve ölçüyü aşmadır; yarışma ve yulara üstün gelme bunun özel, doğruyu reddetmeye bağlı olmayan gerçekleşmeleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bağımsız biçimlerdeki azma ve bile bile karşı çıkma çekirdeğini, kişiyle boy ölçüşme ve yulara karşı koyma gibi belirli kuruluşlara bağlı kullanımlardan ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir sınırı aşarak doğru olduğu bilinen şeyi kabul etmemek ve ona karşı direnmek; belirli kuruluşlarda bir rakibe karşı durup onunla boy ölçüşmeye ya da yönetenin denetimini zorla kırmaya uzanır.

facets.statement: Kişi ölçüyü aşar, doğruyu bildiği halde onu kabul etmez ve karşı koyar.
Birine karşı durup onunla boy ölçüşmek, kimi durumda onun yaptığının benzerini yaparak yarışmak anlamına gelir.
Deve, yulara yüklenip onu tutan kişiye üstün gelerek onu çekebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların birleşen anlatımı, ölçüyü aşma ile bilinen doğruyu reddeden bilinçli direnişi merkeze alır; karşılıklı boy ölçüşme ve denetimi zorla kırma bu çekirdeğin daha özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bağımsız biçimlerin taşıdığı bilinçli ret, direnme ve ölçüyü aşma çekirdeğini birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilinçli reddi, karşı koymayı ve sınırı aşmayı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka biriyle karşılıklı yarıştığı veya onun davranışına denk bir davranışla karşılık verdiği bağlama uygundur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, yol veya amaçlanan doğrultudan yana sapmayı, bir topluluktan ayrı bir yanda durmayı ve çeşitli varlıkların ortak yönden ayrılmasını açıkça bir araya getirir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu uzamsal ayrılma çekirdeğini doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki ayrılma karşı koyma niyetini gerektirmez; yön, yer ve topluluğa katılma bakımından yana çıkmayı anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yan ve taraf bildiren bağımsız biçimi; yoldan sapma, sürüden ayrı durma ve ortak yönden çıkma bildiren belirli kuruluşlarla karıştırmadan kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir yolun, amaçlanan doğrultunun ya da topluluğun ortak çizgisinden yana ayrılmak ve ayrı bir tarafta durmak; yan bildiren ad ile canlıların, yolun ve bir okun bu ayrılığı gösteren özel kullanımlarını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir varlık izlenen yoldan veya ortak doğrultudan yana sapar.
Bir kişi ya da deve topluluğa karışmayıp ayrı bir yanda durur.
Bir bağımsız biçim doğrudan yan veya taraf anlamı taşır.
Yolun eğik uzanması, saplama vuruşunun sağa sola gitmesi ve bir okun ötekilerden başka yönde çıkması bu ayrılmanın özel örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşen kanıt, ortak yol veya topluluktan yana ayrılma çekirdeğini; yan adı, ayrı duran insan ve deve, eğik yol ve başka yönde çıkan ok gibi somut gerçekleşmelerle gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: ortak doğrultudan yana sapıp ayrı durma
concept_gloss.applicability: Yönsel sapma ile bir topluluğa karışmayıp ayrı bir tarafta kalma çekirdeğini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yana sapma, ortak çizgiden ayrılma ve ayrı durma bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yol, canlı veya hareket amaçlanan doğrultudan bir yana çıktığında doğal karşılıktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, belirli görevli biçimin bir nesneyle kullanıldığında sözü dinleyeni onu almaya çağıran bir buyruk olduğunu açıkça belirtir ve bunu benzer buyurucu yapılarla aynı yapı içinde gösterir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu özel işlevi doğru sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kullanım yalın yakınlık bildirmez; sözü dinleyene bir şeyi almasını veya ona bağlı kalmasını doğrudan söyler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca sözü dinleyenin almasını veya tutmasını isteyen görevli biçime bağlıdır; yakınlık bildiren genel kullanıma ya da bağımsız kök anlamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sözü dinleyeni belirtilen nesneyi almaya veya onu elinde tutmaya çağıran kalıplaşmış bir buyruk işlevi görür.

facets.statement: Konuşan, sözü dinleyene belirtilen nesneyi almasını buyurur veya güçlü biçimde salık verir.
Buyruk, nesneyi edinmenin yanı sıra ona bağlı kalmayı da bağlama göre çağrıştırabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşen kanıt, görevli biçimin düz bir yakınlık ilişkisi kurmak yerine sözü dinleyene belirtilen şeyi almasını veya ona bağlı kalmasını söyleyen kalıplaşmış buyruk işlevini destekler.

concept_gloss.text: sözü dinleyeni almaya veya tutmaya yönelten buyruk
concept_gloss.applicability: Belirtilen nesnenin alınmasını, benimsenmesini veya elde tutulmasını isteyen özel görevli kullanımı karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Buyruk gücünü, sözü dinleyene yönelişi ve alma ya da tutma sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Konuşanın sözü dinleyene belirli bir nesneyi doğrudan almasını söylediği bağlamda en doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğrudan buyruğu ve nesneyi edinme sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Nesneye yönelme veya onu bırakmadan tutma çağrışımını tek başına vermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirtilen şeyin benimsenmesi, elde tutulması veya bırakılmaması istendiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeye yönelme ve onu bırakmadan tutma çağrısını korur.
error_profile.loses: Somut bir nesneyi doğrudan alma buyruğunu her bağlamda karşılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Benzer başka gösterici buyrukları ve genel olarak uzatılan şeyi alma çağrısını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da sözü dinleyene önündeki veya belirtilen şeyi almasını söyleyen kalıplaşmış buyruklar içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İşlevleri yakındır, ancak odak dal yalnızca kendi görevli biçiminin alma ve bağlı kalma alanına bağlıdır; komşu dal başka bir gösterici buyruk ve benzerlerini kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirtilen nesneyi alma, ona bağlı kalma veya onu tutma çağrısı yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir işi zorunlu ya da güçlü biçimde salık verilmiş gösterir ve nesne edinmeyi gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: almaya çağrı ile işi üstlenme buyruğu
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kalıplaşmış bir sözle sözü dinleyeni güçlü biçimde bir eyleme çağırma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın hedefi bir nesnenin alınması veya tutulmasıdır; komşu dal ise bir işin yapılmasını yükümlülük gibi sunar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Alma eylemini gerçekleştirmeye çağıran görevsel ve kalıplaşmış buyruktur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi edinme, tutma ve elde etme eyleminin kendisini geniş kapsamıyla anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Belirtilen nesnenin edinilmesi veya ele alınması iki dalın ortak sonuç alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir eylemi adlandırmaz, o eyleme çağıran sözdür; komşu dal doğrudan alma ve elde tutma eylemini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün komşu adayları değerlendirildi; gösterici alma buyruğu, işi üstlenmeye çağrı ve alma eylemi işlev sınırını belirginleştirdi, kalanlar erişme, izinsiz davranma veya konuşmaktan kaçınma gibi ayrı alanlardaydı.

concept_gloss.text: Sözü dinleyeni belirtilen nesneyi almaya veya onu elinde tutmaya çağıran kalıplaşmış bir buyruk işlevi görür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bilinen işitme organını temel alır ve biçim benzerliğiyle kap tutamağına aktarımı açıkça destekler. Kulaklı ya da büyük kulaklı olma, kulak biçimli parça yapma ve kulağa vurma gibi kullanımlar da bu somut çekirdeğe bağlı türevlerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal dinleme, bilme, bildirme veya bir işi yapma yetkisi verme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, organ adını merkezde tutar; kap tutamağı, niteleme ve eylem anlamlarını yalnızca kendi türemiş biçimlerine bağlı olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Kulak, işitmeye yarayan beden organıdır; benzer biçimli kap tutamaklarına aktarılır ve kulaklılık, büyük kulaklılık, kulak biçimli parça yapma ya da kulağa vurup ovma anlatımlarına temel olur.

facets.statement: Temel gönderge, canlıların işitmeye yarayan kulak organıdır.
Biçim benzerliğiyle bir kupa, kap veya tencerenin kulak biçimli tutamağını da gösterebilir.
Türemiş nitelemeler, kulağı bulunanı veya kulakları büyük olanı belirtir.
Türemiş eylemler, bir nesneye kulak biçimli parça eklemeyi ya da birinin kulağına vurup kulağını ovmayı anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, beden organını ortak çekirdek sayar; kap tutamağını biçim benzerliğiyle bu çekirdeğe bağlar ve kulakla ilgili niteleme ile eylemleri aynı anlam çevresinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın somut organ çekirdeğini ve nesnelere biçim benzerliğiyle aktarılan başlıca uzantısını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Hem beden organını hem de ona benzeyen tutamak uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Canlının işitme organından söz edilen olağan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Beden organı olan temel göndergeyi eksiksiz korur.
error_profile.loses: Kap tutamağına aktarımı ve kulağa bağlı türemiş niteleme ile eylemleri dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kupa, kap veya tencerenin kulak biçimindeki tutamağı anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Biçim benzerliğine dayanan nesne uzantısını açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Canlıdaki işitme organını ve öteki türemiş kullanımları dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kulak biçimli nesne tutamaklarını ve kulağa bağlı türemiş niteleme ile eylemleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İşitmenin gerçekleştiği açıklık veya yer yönünü ayrıca öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da canlıdaki kulak organını doğrudan gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal anatomik organı ve işitme yerini sınır alırken bu dal aynı organı nesne tutamağına benzetmenin ve kulakla ilgili türetmelerin merkezi yapar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kulak organının kendisini ve kulak biçimli nesne uzantısını gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kulağın küçük, yapışık veya dar açıklıklı oluşunu özel bir nitelik olarak gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak alanı kulak ve kulağın görünüşüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kulağın kendisini adlandırır; komşu dal ise kulağın belirli bir küçük, yapışık veya dar biçimini nitelediği için yerine geçemez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Beden organını ve ona biçimce benzeyen nesne parçalarını gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Söylenene kulak verme, onu benimseme ve ona uyma eylemini gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal işitme senaryosunda aynı organ çevresinde ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal somut organı adlandırır, komşu dal ise o organla gerçekleştirilen dikkatli dinleme ve benimseme davranışını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yayımlanan üç karşılaştırma anatomik eşdeğeri, kulağın özel biçimini ve aynı kökteki dinleme dalını en açıklayıcı biçimde ayırır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأذن المؤنثة والجمع آذان، وذو الأذن وآذن وأذناء وأذاني، وعروة الكوز والقدر وما جعل له أذن، وضرب الأذن وعركها
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الاستماع ولا العلم ولا الإعلام ولا الإذن بالأمر
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأذن معروفة مؤنثة؛ أذن كل ذي أذن (maqayis)؛ هو أذن؛ الأذن العروة أي عروة الكوز (ayn)؛ الأذن تخفف وتثقل وهي مؤنثة؛ رجل أذاني؛ أذنت النعل إذا جعلت لها أذنا (sihah)؛ آذان الكيزان عراها؛ أذنت فلانا إذا ضربت أذنه (tahdhib)؛ الأذن الجارحة وشبه به أذن القدر وغيرها (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü yalnızca ses algılamayı değil, söylenene yönelerek dinlemeyi ve kimi bağlamlarda duyulanı benimseyip ona uymayı açıkça bir arada verir. Herkesi dinleyip söyleneni kabul eden kişiye yönelik niteleme bu eylemsel çekirdeğin kişiye aktarımıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal somut kulak organını, başkasına bilgi vermeyi veya bir işe onay vermeyi içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, dikkatli dinleme çekirdeğini korur; kabul, uyma ve kişiyi niteleme anlamlarını yalnızca desteklenen biçim ve söz öbeklerine bağlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Söylenene kulak vermek ve bağlama göre onu benimseyip uymaktır; ayrıca herkesi çokça dinleyip duyduğunu kabul eden kişiyi niteler.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir söze dikkat yönelterek onu dinlemektir.
Bazı bağlamlarda dinleme, duyulanı kabul etmeyi ve buyruğa uymayı da içerir.
Kişiye uygulanan niteleme, herkesi veya her şeyi çokça dinleyip duyduğunu kabul eden kimseyi gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dikkatle dinleme çekirdeğinde birleşir; kabul ve uyma sonucunu belirli bağlamlarda ekler, ayrıca çok dinleyen ve duyduğuna kolayca uyan kişi nitelemesini kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dikkatli dinleme çekirdeği ile bağlama bağlı kabul ve uyma yönünü birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem yönelerek dinlemeyi hem de duyulanı benimseme yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir söze dikkat yöneltip onu dinleme bağlamlarında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Dikkatli ve yönelmiş dinleme eylemini doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Duyulanı kabul etme veya buyruğa uyma sonucunu zorunlu olarak belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dinlemenin kabul ve davranışsal uyumla sonuçlandığı buyruk bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dinleme ile kabul edip uyma aşamalarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çok dinleyen ve duyduğunu kolayca benimseyen kişiyi niteleyen kullanım içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye yönelik sürekli dinleme ve kabul etme niteliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: her söyleneni dinleyip kabul eden kişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Duyulanı kabul etme, buyruğa uyma ve çok dinleyen kişiyi niteleme yönlerini de taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dinlemeyi özellikle konuşana yöneltilmiş bir dikkat verme hareketi olarak sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da konuşana yönelerek dikkatli dinleme eylemini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal dikkati konuşana verme hareketinde kalır; bu dal ise dinlemenin kabul ve uyma sonucuna ulaşmasını ve kişisel bir nitelik olmasını da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dikkatli dinlemeye kabul, uyma ve çok dinleyen kişi niteliğini ekleyebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sesi kulakla algılamayı ve genel işitme eylemini, dikkat ya da kabul koşulu olmadan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da sesin kulak yoluyla alınması ve dinlenmesi alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yönelmiş dinleme ve kimi zaman kabul gerektirir; komşu dal ise salt ses algısını da kapsadığı için daha geniş bir işitme alanına sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Söze yönelme ve onu dinleme aşamasını çekirdek yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sözü anlamayı ve anladıktan sonra gereğini yerine getirmeyi ayrıca çekirdek yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal duyulan sözün kabul edilmesi ve ona uyulması çevresinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal dinlemeden kabul ve uyuma ilerler; komşu dal ise anlama ile sonraki uygulamayı öne çıkarır ve dinleme hareketini tek başına yeterli saymaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilen üç komşu dikkatli dinleme, salt işitme ve anlayıp uygulama arasındaki aşama farklarını doğrudan gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أذن للشيء بمعنى استمع، والإنصات، وسمع الطاعة والقبول، ووصف من يسمع من كل أحد ويقبل
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد الجارحة ولا الإعلام ولا الإذن للغير
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأذن الاستماع؛ رجل سامع من كل أحد أذن (maqayis)؛ أذن له استمع؛ رجل أذنة يستمع لكل شيء (ayn)؛ أذن له أذنا استمع؛ رجل أذن إذا كان يسمع مقال كل أحد ويقبله (sihah)؛ أذنت للشيء إذا استمعت له؛ هو أذن أي يستمع فيقبل؛ وأذنت لربها أي سمعت سمع طاعة وقبول (tahdhib)؛ أذن استمع؛ ويستعار لمن كثر استماعه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bilme ile başkasına bildirmeyi aynı dalda açıkça kurar. Sesli duyuru, namazı ve namaz vaktini bildiren çağrı, çağrıyı yapan kişi ve çağrının yapıldığı ya da ulaştığı yer bu bilgi aktarımı çekirdeğine bağlı özel türevlerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal salt dinlemeyi veya birine eylem yetkisi vermeyi değil, bilginin edinilmesini ve başkasına ulaştırılmasını anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bilme ve bildirme çekirdeğini korur; sesli çağrı, çağrıcı ve çağrı yeri anlamlarını yalnızca bunları taşıyan özel biçimlere bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bilmek ya da başkasına bildirmektir; bildirme sesli çağrı biçimi aldığında çağrının kendisini, çağrıcıyı ve çağrının yapıldığı veya ulaştığı yeri gösteren türevler doğurur.

facets.statement: Birinci çekirdek yön, bir şey hakkında bilgi sahibi olmaktır.
İkinci çekirdek yön, bir bilgiyi başka bir kişiye bildirmektir.
Bildirme, genel bir sesli duyuruya veya özel olarak namazı ve namaz vaktini bildiren çağrıya özelleşebilir.
Türemiş adlar çağrıyı, çağrıyı yapan kişiyi, çağrının yapıldığı kuleyi veya sesin her yönden ulaştığı yeri gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bilme ve bildirme yönlerinde birleşir; bildirmenin genel sesli çağrıya ve özel olarak namazı ve namaz vaktini bildiren çağrıya özelleşmesini, ayrıca bu çağrılara bağlı kişi, kule ile erişim yeri adlarını aynı dalda toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın bilgi sahibi olma ile bilgiyi başkasına ulaştırma biçimindeki iki çekirdek yönünü birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bilginin edinilmesi ile başkasına aktarılması yönlerini birlikte korur.

Bilgi dahilinde olma tek başına yetkilendirme gerektirmediğinden izin merkezli dal çerçevesi bu açıklamayı ayrıca koruyacak biçimde nitelendirilmiştir. facets.statement: Temel ilişki, bir kişiye belirli bir işi yapma veya bir yere girme onayı ve yetkisi vermektir.
Dönüşlü isteme biçimi, yetki sahibinden bu onay ve yetkiyi talep etmeyi anlatır.
Bir işin birinin bilgisi dahilinde yapılması veya onun buyruğuyla yapılması, bu dalda korunan iki kaynak açıklamasıdır.
Kişi adı, yöneticiye veya başka bir yere girişe onay veren kapı görevlisini gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar eyleme veya girişe izin vermeyi ve izin istemeyi kaydeder; ayrıca bir işin birinin bilgisi dahilinde ya da buyruğuyla yapılmasını ve girişe izin veren görevliyi aynı dalda toplar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, kişinin belirli işi kesinlikle yapacağını söyleyerek o işi kendisi için bağlayıcı kılmasını temel açıklama olarak verir. Aynı toplu kaynak sözü bunun daha yalın biçimde açıkça bildirme diye anlaşılabildiğini de gösterdiğinden, dal yalnızca kararlılık veya yalnızca duyuru olarak daraltılamaz.
